name: PCam MobileNetV3-Small, Hibou-B-distilled

provenance.training: fine-tuned on PCam (8 epochs, best epoch 6, strong augmentation + EMA, 256-batch)

runtime.runs_on: this clinic PC only: no cloud, no data leaves the clinic (TDD 1.2, 7.1)

measured_per_slide_s.context: median warmed run, 150 patches, batch 16, 4 threads, i5-13400F (150 patches, batch 16, 4 threads, onnxruntime 1.31.0). Same-graph reference: the distilled student is the same MobileNetV3-Small graph as the measured direct model.

plism.source: plism_model_fp32_kd-hibou.json (evaluated as model_fp32_kd-hibou.onnx: the same distilled weights later shipped as model_fp32.onnx)
plism.metric: share of normal lymph-node patches flagged (P ≥ 0.5)

other_tissues_false_alarm.note: normal non-lymph tissue on phones: not valid, see limitations

comparison.model: This model: MobileNetV3-Small, distilled from Hibou-B

comparison.note: most accurate, but too large and slow for a clinic CPU

literature.note: Published results on the same PCam test split (32,768 patches), quoted from the paper's results table, not re-run here.
literature.source: Veeling et al., Rotation Equivariant CNNs for Digital Pathology, MICCAI 2018, Table 1

limitations: Trained only on lymph-node metastases (breast cancer, PCam). Not valid for other organs: normal non-lymph tissue false alarms were 22%–35% on phones at the correct magnification (PLISM).
Needs a calibrated magnification (issue #35): at captured scale the same phones falsely flagged 42–74% of normal lymph-node patches; 0–9% at 0.6x. Always capture with a setup + objective.
Slide thresholds were tuned on slides simulated from PCam validation patches (normal slides: 0.4% red, 5.8% yellow-or-red on test); re-tune on real captures.
Prioritisation aid only, not a diagnostic engine: every slide must be reviewed by a pathologist (TDD 1.2).
